result.stdout:
Usage: yamca [workspace-path] [options]

Arguments:
  workspace-path        Directory to sandbox the agent to (default: current directory).

Options:
  -p, --port <n>        Listen on a specific port (default: 9001).
      --no-browser      Do not open the default browser on startup.
  -h, --help            Show this help and exit.
      --version         Print the tool version and exit.
